---
title: "Posts"
listing:
  id: posts
  type: metadata
  contents: posts/*.qmd
  sort: "date desc"
components:
  - name: tag-filter
    src: tag-filter.tsx
    content: none
---

Every post below carries one or more tags. With JavaScript, the tag
buttons narrow the list; without it, the page shows the whole list,
grouped by year, as the cell below wrote it.

```{lmd}
-- The listing resolved the posts and published them at
-- `meta.listings.posts`; this cell turns the items into (1) plain data
-- for the component and (2) the no-script markup.
local items = meta.listings.posts.items

local rows = items:map(function(it)
  return {
    title = pandoc.utils.stringify(it.title),
    href = it["output-href"],
    date = it.date,
    year = it["date-iso"]:sub(1, 4),
    tags = it.categories,
    description = pandoc.utils.stringify(it.description or ""),
  }
end)

-- Every tag once, most used first, then alphabetical.
local counts = {}
for _, it in ipairs(items) do
  for _, tag in ipairs(it.categories) do
    counts[tag] = (counts[tag] or 0) + 1
  end
end
local tags = {}
for tag, n in pairs(counts) do tags[#tags + 1] = { name = tag, count = n } end
table.sort(tags, function(a, b)
  if a.count ~= b.count then return a.count > b.count end
  return a.name < b.name
end)

-- The no-script version: one section per year, newest first.
local by_year, years = {}, {}
for _, it in ipairs(items) do
  local y = it["date-iso"]:sub(1, 4)
  if not by_year[y] then
    by_year[y] = {}
    years[#years + 1] = y
  end
  table.insert(by_year[y], it)
end

local blocks = pandoc.Blocks({})
for _, y in ipairs(years) do
  blocks:extend({=:
### `{lmd} y`
:=})
  blocks:insert(pandoc.BulletList(pandoc.List(by_year[y]):map(function(it)
    return {=:
`{lmd} pandoc.Link(it.title, it.path)` (`{lmd} it.date`; tagged `{lmd} table.concat(it.categories, ", ")`)
:=}
  end)))
end

return quarto.component("tag-filter", { posts = rows, tags = tags }, blocks)
```
